chars.BOSS: a heavyset Moroccan man in his fifties with a thick grey moustache, balding head, wearing a dark olive quilted vest over a white button shirt
chars.NARRATOR: a slim Moroccan young man about 22 with short black hair, wearing a grey t-shirt dusted with aluminium powder and dark navy work trousers
chars.DAUGHTER: a pretty Moroccan young woman about 20 with long dark hair in a low ponytail, wearing a mustard-yellow cardigan over a white top and light blue jeans

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Vertical 2D cartoon illustration, flat colours. Close view through the windshield of an old white Dacia car parked on a Mohammedia street: BOSS behind the wheel, both hands gripping it, leaning forward and glaring sideways out of the window with wide angry eyes, face clearly visible, head-to-waist framing. Seen from the sidewalk. Calm sunny street background at the edges. No text, no letters, no signs.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Vertical 2D cartoon illustration, flat colours. NARRATOR walking out of a small Moroccan hardware shop (droguerie) holding a small plastic bag of screws, looking ahead casually, Mohammedia neighbourhood street, morning light. Shelves of tools behind him. No text, no letters, no signs.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Vertical 2D cartoon illustration, flat colours. In front of a neighbourhood bakery in Mohammedia, DAUGHTER steps out of the door carrying a paper bag with baguettes and round Moroccan bread, and almost bumps into NARRATOR on the sidewalk; both surprised, she looks up at him, he stands stiff trying to look cool. Faces visible, centred. No text, no letters, no signs.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Vertical 2D cartoon illustration, flat colours. On the sidewalk outside the bakery, DAUGHTER holding her bread bag gives NARRATOR a big warm shy smile, tilting her head; NARRATOR smiles back nervously, scratching the back of his neck; both laughing a little. Faces visible in the centre, calm street behind. No text, no letters, no signs.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Vertical 2D cartoon illustration, flat colours. Foreground: NARRATOR and DAUGHTER chatting and laughing on the sidewalk. Just behind them on the street an old white Dacia car drives slowly past, BOSS staring at them through the open window with a cold furious look; NARRATOR notices him, his smile freezing. Faces visible. No text, no letters, no signs.
